ownership_contract: Full tapered/nonconvex functional face belongs to its contact component; no centre rectangle plus old inward guard strips
Every exposed assembly face must have one explained owner; internal component closure faces stay internal
Distinct real adjacent surfaces may both contact the same object; contact coexistence alone does not establish duplicate force
Protective is a usage role, never an object-specific collision disable or zero-force region
Do not copy any Panda material, count, dimensions or actuator topology
